title: i18n(platform-objects): ship the platform objects, Setup, Studio and Account in Arabic
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"marchtian"} -->
_Requested by **田騏** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSi?thread=cmsg_01VmuUhXU9SSUzqJYyXSmYSiP9RS1KjicEPyef7VNhFzFa)_

Part of #30512
Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读
- 业务影响：阿拉伯语（ar）用户打开平台对象、Setup、Studio 和 Account 时，界面不再是英文。
- 范围：只动 `@objectstack/platform-objects`，按 #30951 加 zh-Hant 的同一套路加 ar；spec、ui、邮件模板都不碰。
- 翻译：从 main 的 en 源重新翻译 3078 个叶子，术语对齐 ui/packages/i18n 的 ar；只有 17 个标识符（JWKS、cron、JSON 示例等）保留英文。
- 跨包对齐：审批、分配规则、各设置页的导航名与对应包的 ar 标题逐字一致，并由现有测试守住。
- 风险：只新增语言与测试里的语言列表，不改任何既有语言的文本；新文本同样走 source-hash 回退。
- 合并：生成文件让 PR 超过 3000 行，需要座位契约复审后由人工合并。

## What changes
- New `ar` bundles in `packages/platform-objects/src/apps/translations`: `ar.objects.generated.ts` (1676 leaves), `ar.metadata-forms.generated.ts` (1263 leaves), their provenance table `ar.source-hashes.generated.ts` (16 deliberate echoes), the hand-authored `ar.ts` (139 leaves) and `ar.source-hashes.ts` recording the `en` digest of every hand leaf.
- Registration: the extract config's `--locales` docstring and `translations:` baseline, `setup.translation.ts`, the `apps` barrel, and `metadata-translations/index.ts`.
- Inline maps: 35 in `sys-user.page.ts`, 6 in `sys-organization.page.ts`, and the System Overview null label in `system.datasets.ts`.
- Wording pins: `nav_account_approvals` reads as plugin-approvals' `my_pending` label, `nav_assignment_rules` as `sys_assignment_rule`'s plural label, each `nav_settings_*` as its service-settings hub title, and the four #30935 keys (`grp_account_ai_assistant`, both `nav_connect_agent` entries, `pages.connect_agent.label`).
- Changeset `.changeset/30512-platform-objects-ar.md` (patch).

## Tests
- `ar` added to the locale lists of the platform-objects tests that #30951 widened for zh-Hant (vocabulary, nav parity, dead-key tombstone, source-hash, copy tests, record-page tabs, plugin translation loads), plus plugin-approvals `approval-status-vocabulary`, plugin-security `people-org-assignment-nav-contribution` and service-settings `setup-nav-hub-parity`. The cli `platform-page-i18n-parity` LOCALE_KEY shape already accepts `ar`.

## Acceptance notes
- Every leaf is translated; the only byte copies of `en` are identifiers and code examples, and the extract records them in the provenance table.
- Lists of Latin identifiers use the Arabic comma, and no proclitic `و` is glued to a Latin token.
- `Position` on the add-record button is الموضع and the job position is المنصب; a hook's `Body` is المتن.

## Verification
- `os i18n extract ... --locales=zh-CN,ja-JP,es-ES,zh-Hant,ar --fill=default --source-hashes`: regenerates the ar files byte-identical and leaves the other locales unchanged.
- `vitest run` in platform-objects: 117 files, 1683 tests passed. The plugin-approvals, plugin-security, service-settings and cli parity tests passed.
- `dispatch-gates --ran`: 64 derived families, 64 run, 0 NOT-MEASURED, all exit 0 (including `check:i18n`).
- `pnpm lint`, platform-objects `typecheck`, and all 57 commands of the "Lint · docs & code guards" lane (including `check:cli-command-ids`): exit 0.
